functions.name: enqueue_many_v1
functions.contract: SELECT ordinal, job_id, outcome, reason FROM workhorse.enqueue_many_v1($1::jsonb) ORDER BY ordinal

functions.name: heartbeat_many_v1
functions.contract: SELECT job_id::text AS job_id, status FROM workhorse.heartbeat_many_v1($1::text, $2::jsonb) ORDER BY ordinal

functions.name: cancel_v1
functions.contract: SELECT status, state, current_attempt, requested_at, requested_by, reason, finished_at FROM workhorse.cancel_v1($1::uuid, $2::text, $3::text)

functions.name: save_checkpoint_v1
functions.contract: SELECT status, checkpoint_value, attempt, fence_token::text, worker_id, created_at FROM workhorse.save_checkpoint_v1($1::uuid, $2::text, $3::bigint, $4::text, $5::jsonb)

functions.name: update_progress_v1
functions.contract: SELECT status, progress_value, revision::text, attempt, fence_token::text, worker_id, created_at, updated_at, retry_after_ms::text FROM workhorse.update_progress_v1($1::uuid, $2::text, $3::bigint, $4::jsonb)

functions.name: schedule_wait_v1
functions.contract: SELECT status, wait_name, mode, duration_ms::text, requested_wake_at, wake_at, attempt, fence_token::text, worker_id, created_at FROM workhorse.schedule_wait_v1($1::uuid, $2::text, $3::bigint, $4::text, $5::bigint, $6::timestamptz)

functions.name: create_children_v1
functions.contract: SELECT status, children, results, result_bytes, result_limit_bytes FROM workhorse.create_children_v1($1::uuid, $2::text, $3::bigint, $4::jsonb)

functions.name: create_child_v1
functions.contract: SELECT status, child_job_id, child_type, created_at, joined_at, result FROM workhorse.create_child_v1($1::uuid, $2::text, $3::bigint, $4::text, $5::jsonb)

functions.name: send_signal_v1
functions.contract: SELECT status, payload, delivered_at, delivered_by FROM workhorse.send_signal_v1($1::uuid, $2::text, $3::jsonb, $4::text, $5::text)

functions.name: complete_human_wait_v1
functions.contract: SELECT status, result, completed_at, completed_by FROM workhorse.complete_human_wait_v1($1::uuid, $2::text, $3::jsonb, $4::text, $5::text)

views.name: dashboard_signal_wait_v1
views.contract: SELECT job_id, queue_name, job_type, signal_name AS wait_name, attempt, created_at, deadline_at, created_at::text AS cursor_created_at FROM workhorse.dashboard_signal_wait_v1 WHERE ($2::timestamptz IS NULL OR (created_at, job_id, signal_name) > ($2::timestamptz, $3::uuid, $4::text)) ORDER BY created_at, job_id, signal_name LIMIT $1::integer

views.name: dashboard_human_wait_v1
views.contract: SELECT job_id, queue_name, job_type, token_name AS wait_name, context, attempt, created_at, deadline_at, created_at::text AS cursor_created_at FROM workhorse.dashboard_human_wait_v1 WHERE ($2::timestamptz IS NULL OR (created_at, job_id, token_name) > ($2::timestamptz, $3::uuid, $4::text)) ORDER BY created_at, job_id, token_name LIMIT $1::integer
